note: Placeholder thresholds and source history of the sensed-confirmation stop for the fake backend only (SAFE-049); never a device fact, an at-rest bound, a landed height or a recommendation. The history models the fake, whose subscriptions replay nothing but their first (pre-request) sample. A live simulation supplies its own values in simulation_deployment['estop_confirmation'], the /uav/gps history included. The clone states no maximum altitude, so a higher flight must raise confirm_within_ms or the latch stays and retries.
